name: angular-electron-telemetry-monitor
description: Angular + Electron Windows desktop telemetry monitoring application

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k "node scripts/run-backend.mjs" "node scripts/run-frontend.mjs" "wait-on http://localhost:4200 http://localhost:3000/api/health && electron ."
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.start:prod: npm run build && cross-env NODE_ENV=production concurrently -k "node scripts/run-backend.mjs" "wait-on http://localhost:3000/api/health && electron ."
